# Audio files are served statically and cached by the service worker.
# Pre-rendered .mp3 files go in language subdirectories:
#   /audio/sw/   - Swahili
#   /audio/en/   - English
#   /audio/ki/   - Kikuyu
#   /audio/luo/  - Dholuo
#   /audio/kal/  - Kalenjin
#
# Files are generated by the Featherless TTS pipeline (Ephey's task).
# Once generated, they are committed to the repo so the SW can cache them.
#
# Naming convention:
#   {status}_{fertilizer_id}_{lang}.mp3
#   e.g. warn_yara_cadmium_sw.mp3
#        safe_mavuno_planting_en.mp3
#        generic_safe_sw.mp3
